author: agent:claude-code
message: Error is #[non_exhaustive] now that tend (5514297) and alfred have a catch-all arm in From<sylva::Error> (grafts 01a10e58-442a and 01a10e58-4445): features only add again (rust.features-additive). (proposal 01a15b6b-b561-72c7-a0d0-2e62dbc48f7b, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Error is non-exhaustive
body: Features add Error variants (Json with log or knowledge, Io with std, Db with sqlite), and features unify across a build, so an exhaustive match in one crate broke when another crate turned a feature on, against rust.features-additive. With #[non_exhaustive], a match outside sylva needs a catch-all arm; tend and alfred added theirs first (grafts 01a10e58-442a, 01a10e58-4445) and both build against it. Their #[allow(unreachable_patterns)] on that arm is no longer needed.
